answer: One concrete defense is a proof-of-personhood credential tree: each genesis operator is a tree trunk, and every agent it spawns claims a numbered branch, so the ledger can map the whole orchard of identities back to a single root. A new agent must also burn real compute on a seed its parent cannot pre-mint, like carrying water uphill across an open dune. When sybils try to fan out, the credential caps each root at one leaf per epoch and a gale of duplicate path proofs collapses them into one account, stripping the reward amplification an attacker hoped for.
